messages:
maya-marketing: quick flag  noticed a rise in leads stuck as unassigned after enrichment failures overnight (small but steady).

devin-salesops: can you paste an example log or id? want to confirm it's enrichment TTL and not RR mapping.

maya-marketing: sample log:
```
2026-03-20T23:11:02Z WARN enrichment timeout lead=L-4771 elapsed=4200ms
2026-03-20T23:11:02Z INFO fallback -> mark enrichment_status=failed and send to unassigned
```

sam-engineering: thanks. current TTL is 4s after last perf tweak. APAC/EU spikes push HS calls to 4-6s. proposal: feature-flagged "minimal-enrich" fallback that on timeout attaches email+domain and proceeds to round-robin. run 8% canary for 2h.

devin-salesops: prefer canary vs global TTL bump. also request hubspot workflow to tag fallback leads with enrichment_reason and set owner to fallback-queue during canary. hubspot-bot: please schedule workflow change at 01:00 UTC for canary start.

hubspot-bot: scheduled workflow update: enrichment-fallback -> set owner=fallback-queue and add property=enrich_source:fallback_minimal at 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z (requested by devin-salesops).

leo-sdr: request: add saved view "Fallback leads" and a quick playbook line: "try quick reach out, note minimal data." helps triage.

sam-engineering: will add metrics inbound.enrich.fallback.count and inbound.claim.latency.p95. rollout steps in ticket: LINK_INTERNAL. deploying canary now.

maya-marketing: thanks all. please keep SDR comms short and include the playbook link. i'll monitor campaign correlation.
